datasets.name: sales_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) AS net_revenue,
  MEASURE(`Gross Sales`) AS gross_sales,
  MEASURE(`Total Discount`) AS total_discount,
  MEASURE(`Transaction Count`) AS txn_count,
  MEASURE(`Total Units Sold`) AS units_sold,
  MEASURE(`Average Order Value`) AS avg_order_value,
  MEASURE(`Discount Rate`) AS discount_rate,
  MEASURE(`Won Transaction Count`) AS won_txn_count,
  MEASURE(`Transaction Count`) - MEASURE(`Won Transaction Count`) AS lost_txn_count,
  MEASURE(`Won Transaction Count`) / MEASURE(`Transaction Count`) AS won_rate
FROM
  retail.retail_semantic.retail_metrics
GROUP BY
  ALL

datasets.name: sales_monthly
queryLines:
SELECT
  date_trunc('MONTH', `Transaction Date`) AS month,
  MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) AS net_revenue,
  MEASURE(`Gross Sales`) AS gross_sales,
  MEASURE(`Total Discount`) AS total_discount,
  MEASURE(`Transaction Count`) AS txn_count,
  MEASURE(`Total Units Sold`) AS units_sold
FROM
  retail.retail_semantic.retail_metrics
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  month ASC

datasets.name: products
queryLines:
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  category,
  subcategory,
  brand,
  supplier_name,
  unit_price,
  launch_date,
  is_active,
  is_current,
  valid_from,
  valid_to
FROM
  retail.gold.dim_product
ORDER BY
  product_name,
  valid_from

datasets.name: opportunity_stage
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(stage_name, 'Unassigned') AS stage_name,
  CASE
    WHEN is_won THEN 'Won'
    ELSE 'Lost'
  END AS outcome,
  COUNT(1) AS txn_count,
  SUM(quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM
  retail.gold.fact_sales
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(stage_name, 'Unassigned'),
  CASE
    WHEN is_won THEN 'Won'
    ELSE 'Lost'
  END
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC

datasets.name: top_products
datasets.displayName: Top Products by Net Revenue (Metric View)
queryLines:
SELECT
  `Product Name` AS product_name,
  MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) AS net_revenue,
  MEASURE(`Total Units Sold`) AS units_sold,
  MEASURE(`Transaction Count`) AS txn_count
FROM
  retail.retail_semantic.retail_metrics
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: sales_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  `Category` AS category,
  `Subcategory` AS subcategory,
  `Brand` AS brand,
  `Store` AS store,
  `Payment Mode` AS payment_mode,
  `Sales Channel` AS sales_channel,
  `Opportunity Stage` AS stage_name,
  MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) AS net_revenue,
  MEASURE(`Gross Sales`) AS gross_sales,
  MEASURE(`Total Discount`) AS total_discount,
  MEASURE(`Transaction Count`) AS txn_count,
  MEASURE(`Total Units Sold`) AS units_sold,
  MEASURE(`Won Transaction Count`) AS won_txn_count
FROM
  retail.retail_semantic.retail_metrics
GROUP BY
  ALL

datasets.name: inventory
queryLines:
SELECT
  fi.product_id,
  dp.product_name,
  fi.category,
  fi.subcategory,
  fi.brand,
  fi.store_id,
  fi.warehouse_location,
  fi.stock_quantity,
  fi.reorder_level,
  fi.needs_restock,
  CASE
    WHEN fi.needs_restock THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS restock_flag,
  fi.unit_price_at_snapshot,
  fi.stock_value,
  fi.last_stock_update
FROM
  retail.gold.fact_inventory fi
    LEFT JOIN retail.gold.dim_product dp
      ON fi.product_sk = dp.product_sk
ORDER BY
  fi.stock_value DESC

datasets.name: customers
queryLines:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  customer_type,
  industry,
  billing_city,
  billing_state,
  billing_country,
  is_buyer,
  customer_since
FROM
  retail.gold.dim_customer
ORDER BY
  customer_name
